hooks.command:
git rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; printf "=== PROJECT IDENTITY ===
repo:   %s
branch: %s (ships from main)
tree:   %s uncommitted file(s)
If this is not the project named in this chat, STOP and say so. Never derive a repo, a branch or a project name from the chat title. Read CLAUDE.md in this directory before your first action.
=======================
" "$(git config --get remote.origin.url)" "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" "$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

git rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; printf "[git ground truth] branch=%s | %s uncommitted | %s unpushed commit(s) — work that is not on main is not shipped\n" "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" "$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" "$(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
